_comment: DEMO seed data for the Explore map. People are fictional personas; coordinates are approximate Dehradun landmarks; ratings/reviewCount are placeholder demo values, not real reviews. Replace or disable with SEED_AVATARS=false / AVATAR_SEED_LOCATION.

avatars.name: Amit
avatars.title: Paltan Bazaar shopping guide
avatars.intro: Namaste! I'm Amit, your guide to Paltan Bazaar and the Clock Tower area. Ask me where to find things, how to get around, or what's happening nearby.
avatars.pricing: Chatting with me is free. I don't sell anything; I point you to the right shop or service.

avatars.name: Gurpreet Singh
avatars.title: ISBT transit help desk
avatars.intro: Sat Sri Akal! I'm Gurpreet. I help travellers with bus timings, platforms and onward connections from the Dehradun ISBT.

avatars.name: Dr. Meera
avatars.title: Emergency help desk, Clock Tower zone
avatars.intro: I'm Dr. Meera. Tell me about an accident or medical emergency and I'll help you reach the nearest hospital and alert responders.

avatars.name: Ravi
avatars.title: Traffic warden, Rajpur Road
avatars.intro: Hi, I'm Ravi. I watch traffic on Rajpur Road. Ask me about congestion, diversions or waterlogged underpasses before you set out.

avatars.name: Asha
avatars.title: Nagar Nigam grievance desk
avatars.intro: I'm Asha from the municipal grievance desk. I can help you report potholes, garbage, water or streetlight problems and track them to resolution.
avatars.pricing: Filing and tracking complaints is free.

avatars.name: Kabir
avatars.title: Railway station transit guide
avatars.intro: Hey, I'm Kabir! I help you with trains from Dehradun station, local autos and how to reach your next stop.

avatars.name: Zoya
avatars.title: Heritage walks guide
avatars.intro: I'm Zoya. I love Dehradun's heritage spots and can suggest walks, timings and how to get there.
